reason: Yes, knowingly accepting the four residuals stated in the bill's own section 9.3. As the non-sponsor red-teamer, I reviewed the prior draft and found T1-T11; nine were accepted and changed the text, T2/T3 were accepted in part with residues disclosed, and T7 is now stated as an express Act 21 timing amendment rather than a false 'same gate' claim. The design is prospective, fail-closed, keeps exact-commit/fast-forward, makes the Git copy authoritative, bounds the post-landing copy, and names the Git-native alternatives the House may prefer. I do not treat the section 9.3 residuals U1-U4 as clean, but they are disclosed and do not create an unaudited landing: a lost or mismatched record voids the landing. I also note the Act 22 gate passed as not_exercised because this bill is outside the Clerk-owned pilot subset; no predictions are registered, and I do not treat that statutory scope exemption as a bar. This is a vote for a real but residual improvement, not a claim that the bill is fully clean.
